items.title: Hiroshi Yoshimura :: Quiet Forest
items.summary: With no deceleration in sight, the 2020s have thus far been the decade of Kankyō Ongaku pioneer Hiroshi Yoshimura. 1996's Quiet Forest , the musician's final offering, is another gem in a slew of reissues courtesy of tireless label Temporal Drift. The Hoh Rainforest is the setting here, as Yoshimura interprets the terrain with his singular approach: superimposed synth soundscapes that contagiously mirror the greenery and precipitation: fluttering new age soundscapes as opulent as they are evocative. The post Hiroshi Yoshimura :: Quiet Forest first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .
